news.goal: بتوانی خبرها را بفهمی، دربارهٔ آن‌ها حرف بزنی و جملهٔ مجهول را بسازی و بفهمی.
news.intro: Welcome! From this level, our class is almost fully in English; I'll switch to Persian only for tricky points. Today: news and media, and the passive voice, which you see in every headline: The bridge was built in 1990.

items: news, headline, article, report, journalist, reporter, editor, newspaper, magazine, website, podcast, broadcast, channel, social media, fake news, source
breaking news, live coverage, interview, press conference
election, government, economy, inflation, crisis, protest, accident, earthquake, flood, investigation, arrest, trial, agreement, deal, launch, record
announce, report, claim, deny, confirm, reveal, warn, injure, damage, rescue, elect, approve, ban

patterns: The new metro line was opened yesterday.
Three people were injured in the accident.
The results will be announced next week.
According to the BBC, …
Have you heard the news about…?
checks: فاعل در جملهٔ مجهول کجا می‌ره؟ (با by)
personal: How do you get your news?
Do you trust social media news?
What's an important news story this week?

examples: English is spoken worldwide.
The road was built in 2010.
The winners will be announced tomorrow.
The suspect has been arrested.
grammar.rule: be (در زمان مناسب) + قسمت سوم فعل. وقتی انجام‌دهنده مهم نیست یا معلوم نیست. انجام‌دهنده با by.

quiz: مجهول: They built it → It was built.

culture.goal: بتوانی دربارهٔ فرهنگ‌ها و آداب و رسوم مقایسه و توضیح بدهی و از should, be supposed to, be allowed to درست استفاده کنی.
culture.intro: Welcome! Today we explore cultures and customs — what's polite, what's rude, and how things differ between Iran, Oman and English-speaking countries. We'll learn to talk about rules and expectations: You're supposed to…, You aren't allowed to…

items: culture, custom, tradition, festival, ceremony, etiquette, manners, taboo, values, belief, religion
polite / rude, formal / informal, generous, hospitable (مهمان‌نواز)
shake hands, bow, kiss on the cheek, take off your shoes, bring a gift, arrive on time, tip, queue
taarof = تعارف (explain to foreigners)
In my country, … whereas in …
It's considered rude to…
People tend to…
It depends on…

patterns: In Iran, you're supposed to take off your shoes at home.
You aren't allowed to smoke here.
You should bring a small gift.
It's considered rude to be late.
In the UK, people tend to queue politely.
checks: should و be supposed to فرق؟ (supposed: قانون/انتظار جامعه)
taarof رو چطور برای یه خارجی توضیح می‌دی؟
roleplay: توضیح نوروز و تعارف به یک خارجی
مهمان خارجی در خانه‌ات: راهنمایی آداب
personal: What's a custom in your country that surprises foreigners?
What's considered rude where you live?
Which culture would you like to learn about?

grammar.point: should / be supposed to / be allowed to / have to
examples: You should try the local food. (توصیه)
You're supposed to arrive on time. (انتظار)
You aren't allowed to take photos. (ممنوع)
You have to show your passport. (اجبار)
grammar.rule: should توصیه؛ be supposed to انتظار یا قاعدهٔ اجتماعی (که گاهی رعایت نمی‌شود)؛ be allowed to اجازه؛ have to اجبار واقعی.

relations.goal: بتوانی دربارهٔ روابط دوستی، خانوادگی و عاطفی حرف بزنی و حال کامل استمراری را برای کارهای ادامه‌دار به کار ببری.
relations.intro: Welcome! Today: relationships — friendships, dating, family and work relationships. We'll use many phrasal verbs (get on with, fall out, break up) and the present perfect continuous: I've been living here for five years.

items: friend, close friend, best friend, acquaintance (آشنا), colleague, partner, boyfriend, girlfriend, fiancé(e), ex
relationship, friendship, marriage, trust, respect, support, argument, jealousy
get on (well) with = رابطهٔ خوب داشتن
get along with (US)
fall out with = قهر کردن
make up = آشتی کردن
break up (with) = جدا شدن/کات کردن
ask someone out = پیشنهاد قرار دادن
go out with = دوست بودن/قرار گذاشتن
fall for = عاشق شدن
look up to = الگو دانستن
count on = روی کسی حساب کردن
put up with = تحمل کردن
supportive, loyal, trustworthy, caring, controlling, jealous, we have a lot in common

patterns: I've been living in Muscat for three years.
How long have you been learning English?
I get on really well with my sister.
They broke up last month, but now they've made up.
You can always count on me.
checks: حال کامل و حال کامل استمراری فرق؟
roleplay: دلداری دادن به دوستی که رابطه‌اش تمام شده
دو دوست بعد از دعوا آشتی می‌کنند
personal: Who do you get on with best in your family?
How long have you known your best friend?
What makes a good friend?

examples: I've been waiting for an hour.
How long have you been working here?
She's been studying all day, so she's tired.
grammar.rule: have/has been + ing برای کاری که از گذشته شروع شده و هنوز ادامه دارد یا تازه تمام شده و نتیجه‌اش پیداست؛ با for و since. فعل‌های حالتی (know, love) استمراری نمی‌شوند: I've known him for years.

quiz: I've ___ (know/been knowing) him for years → known
«روی من حساب کن» → Count on me.
«ما وجه مشترک زیادی داریم» → We have a lot in common.

business.goal: بتوانی در جلسه و مذاکرهٔ تجاری شرکت کنی، پیشنهاد بدهی و با شرطی نوع دوم موقعیت فرضی را بیان کنی.
business.intro: Welcome! Today: business and negotiation — especially useful for your work. We'll learn meeting and negotiation phrases and the second conditional: If you lowered the price, we would order more.

items: company, firm, business, startup, client, supplier, partner, competitor, market, product, service, profit, loss, revenue, budget, investment, contract, deal, invoice, quote (پیش‌فاکتور)
import / export, customs, logistics, trade, free zone
Let's get started. / Shall we begin?
The purpose of this meeting is…
Could you clarify that?
I'd like to add something.
Let's move on to the next point.
To sum up, …
We're looking for a long-term partnership.
Could you offer a discount for bulk orders?
That's a bit higher than we expected.
What if we…?
I'm afraid we can't accept that.
Let's meet halfway. = بیایید وسط راه توافق کنیم
We have a deal.

patterns: If you gave us a 10% discount, we would sign today.
What would you do if you were the manager?
Could you send us a quote?
I'm afraid that's not possible.
Let's meet halfway.
checks: If I would have…؟ (نه؛ If I had)
roleplay: ارائهٔ کوتاه منطقهٔ آزاد به یک سرمایه‌گذار خارجی
personal: What would you do if you had your own company?
Have you ever negotiated a deal?
What makes a good business partner?

examples: If I had more money, I would start a business.
If I were you, I'd accept the offer.
What would you do if you lost your job?
grammar.rule: If + گذشتهٔ ساده، would + فعل ساده. برای موقعیت فرضی یا غیرواقعی در حال/آینده. برای همه اشخاص were رایج است (If I were you).
drill: اگه جای تو بودم قبول می‌کردم →
اگه قیمت پایین‌تر بود، بیشتر سفارش می‌دادیم →

quiz: «بیایید وسط راه توافق کنیم» → Let's meet halfway.

complaints.goal: بتوانی مؤدبانه و مؤثر شکایت کنی، مشکل را حل کنی و حرف دیگران را با نقل قول غیرمستقیم بازگو کنی.
complaints.intro: Welcome! Today: problems and complaints — in a hotel, a shop, with a company. We'll learn to complain politely but firmly, and reported speech: He said that… / She asked me if…

items: broken, damaged, faulty, missing, wrong, late, delayed, dirty, noisy, overcharged
refund, replacement, compensation, apology, manager, customer service, warranty
I'm afraid there's a problem with…
I'd like to make a complaint.
I'm not happy with…
This isn't what I ordered.
Could you look into it, please?
I'd like a refund / a replacement.
I'd like to speak to the manager.
I'm so sorry about that.
Let me see what I can do.
We'll sort it out right away.
I'll get back to you.

patterns: I'm afraid the room is too noisy.
The receptionist said that they would change our room.
She asked me if I had the receipt.
He told me to wait.
I was overcharged by twenty dollars.
checks: said و told فرق؟ (told + مفعول: told me)
در نقل قول غیرمستقیم زمان چطور عوض می‌شه؟
I'm afraid اینجا یعنی می‌ترسم؟ (نه؛ متأسفانه/مؤدبانه)
roleplay: شکایت در هتل از اتاق پرسروصدا
تماس با پشتیبانی برای سفارش اشتباه
تعریف شکایت برای دوستت با نقل قول غیرمستقیم
personal: Have you ever complained about a product?
How do you usually solve problems with companies?
What annoys you most as a customer?

examples: "I'm tired." → She said (that) she was tired.
"Do you have the receipt?" → He asked if I had the receipt.
"Wait here." → He told me to wait.
grammar.rule: معمولاً زمان یک قدم به عقب می‌رود (am→was, will→would, can→could). سؤال بله/خیر با if، سؤال wh بدون جابه‌جایی فاعل. دستور: told + مفعول + to.

quiz: "I can help" → He said he could help.
«ازم پرسید کجا زندگی می‌کنم» → She asked me where I lived.
«متأسفانه مشکلی هست» → I'm afraid there's a problem.

careers.goal: بتوانی دربارهٔ تحصیلات و مسیر شغلی، رزومه و مصاحبه حرف بزنی و جملات موصولی بسازی.
careers.intro: Welcome! Today: education and careers — CVs, interviews and career paths. We'll use relative clauses to give details smoothly: She's the manager who hired me.

items: career, profession, field, industry, position, role, promotion, experience, skills, qualifications, degree, internship, training, mentor
apply for, be responsible for, specialize in, switch careers, climb the career ladder
Tell me about yourself.
What are your strengths and weaknesses?
Why do you want this job?
Where do you see yourself in five years?
I'm a team player / detail-oriented / a fast learner.
CV/résumé, cover letter, reference, work experience, education, achievements, soft skills, hard skills

patterns: She's the person who interviewed me.
This is the company that I worked for.
That's the university where I studied.
I'm responsible for managing a team of five.
personal: What's your dream career?
What skills are you proud of?
What advice would you give to a new graduate?

examples: The man who called you is my boss.
The report which/that I wrote was approved.
The city where I grew up is small.
My sister, who lives in Canada, is a nurse.
grammar.rule: who برای آدم، which برای چیز، that برای هر دو (در جملهٔ تعریفی)، where برای مکان، whose برای مالکیت. جملهٔ اضافی بین ویرگول that نمی‌گیرد.
drill: این شرکتیه که توش کار می‌کنم →
مردی که بهت زنگ زد مدیرمه →

lifestyle.goal: بتوانی دربارهٔ سبک زندگی سالم، عادت‌ها و تغییرات حرف بزنی و فرق gerund و infinitive را بدانی.
lifestyle.intro: Welcome! Today: health and lifestyle — habits, balance, stress and change. And a classic tricky point: verb + -ing vs verb + to: I enjoy cooking / I decided to quit.

items: work-life balance, routine, habit, wellbeing, mental health, burnout, stress, sleep, diet, exercise, screen time, mindfulness
healthy / balanced / active / sedentary (کم‌تحرک)
give up, cut down on, take up, stick to, get into the habit of, break a habit, set a goal
motivation, willpower
enjoy, avoid, mind, finish, keep, suggest, give up + -ing
want, decide, plan, hope, need, promise, learn + to
start, begin, like, love, hate + هر دو
stop smoking (ترک) / stop to smoke (ایستادن برای سیگار)
remember to do / remember doing

patterns: I enjoy cooking healthy food.
I've decided to cut down on sugar.
Try to avoid using your phone before bed.
I gave up smoking two years ago.
Remember to drink water!
checks: stop doing و stop to do فرق؟
roleplay: دوستت دچار فرسودگی شغلی است و راهکار می‌دهی
personal: What habits would you like to change?
How do you deal with stress?
Do you have a good work-life balance?

examples: I enjoy reading.
She decided to move abroad.
Stop worrying!
I'll never forget meeting you.
grammar.rule: بعضی فعل‌ها فقط ing (enjoy, avoid, finish, mind)، بعضی فقط to (want, decide, hope, plan). بعضی با تغییر معنی (stop, remember, forget, try).
drill: تصمیم گرفتم ورزش رو شروع کنم →

quiz: «کم کردن قند» → cut down on sugar

science.goal: بتوانی دربارهٔ علم، فناوری و آینده حرف بزنی و با must be / might be / can't be استنباط کنی.
science.intro: Welcome to our final lesson of this level! Today: science and the future — AI, space, medicine — and how to make deductions: That must be true / It might be / It can't be.

items: science, scientist, research, experiment, discovery, invention, theory, evidence, data, laboratory
artificial intelligence (AI), robot, space exploration, planet, gene, vaccine, renewable energy, virtual reality
in the near future, by 2050, likely / unlikely, possibility, prediction, breakthrough, replace, develop, invent
must be = حتماً (مطمئن)
might / may / could be = شاید
can't be = امکان ندارد
must have been / can't have been (گذشته)

patterns: Robots might replace many jobs.
That can't be true — it's impossible!
She must be a scientist; she's always in the lab.
By 2050, we will probably live longer.
There's no evidence for that.
checks: must be برای اجبار است یا استنباط؟ (هر دو؛ اینجا استنباط)
must not be مخالف must be است؟ (نه؛ can't be)
roleplay: بحث: آیا هوش مصنوعی جای معلم‌ها را می‌گیرد؟
حدس زدن دربارهٔ یک عکس مرموز
personal: How will AI change our lives?
Would you like to travel to space?
What's the most important invention ever?

examples: He must be tired; he worked all night.
She might be at home.
That can't be Ali; he's in Canada.
They must have left already.
grammar.rule: must be: تقریباً مطمئنیم درست است. might/may/could be: احتمال. can't be: مطمئنیم غلط است. برای گذشته: must/might/can't + have + قسمت سوم.

quiz: «امکان ندارد درست باشد» → It can't be true.
